title: How to AI UXR
author: The ResearchOps Review
description: An eight-part podcast series featuring UX research professionals who are using AI to rethink how research is operationalised. Building on the insights shared in the How to AI UXR map, this series offers practical examples you can adopt or adapt for your own AI-augmented workflows. Brought to you by Strella, a customer research platform that uses AI to run in-depth interviews and generate actionable insights in just a few hours. www.theresearchopsreview.com
